# ESS specification

Every noun of Patchback has a typed home in an ESS domain: the patch and its graph, the score of note events, audio, analysis, the dataset, the model, the fit and the dependency policy. This page and the 9 domain pages below are generated from the repository's `spec/` directory by `patchback-docs`: the graphs from `ess specify compile`, the pages from `ess generate --kind docs`. `task check` fails when they fall behind the specification.

The [contract explorer](./explorer.mdx) shows the whole specification in one searchable view.

## The whole model

Every entity and every relation across the domains. An arrow is a relation, labelled with its name; a lifecycle lists the states an entity moves through.

<DomainGraph data={systemGraph} title="Patchback" />

## analysis

The native analysis library (DESIGN.md 6): STFT, envelope and spectral descriptors of an audio clip with their recorded configuration, the versioned feature contract `features/1`, the feature vectors extracted under it, the training-split normalization statistics, and monophonic note estimation (DESIGN.md 6.1, 6.2, 6.3, 7.1, 10, 12.3).

<DomainGraph data={domainGraph0} title="analysis" />

[Read the analysis domain in full](./patchback-analysis.md)

## audio

Audio clips read from WAV files, clips written back as WAV, and renders of a patch and a note sequence through the native DSP renderer (DESIGN.md sections 3, 5.2, 5.3, 6.1, 11, 12.1, 12.3).

<DomainGraph data={domainGraph1} title="audio" />

[Read the audio domain in full](./patchback-audio.md)

## dataset

Seeded synthetic training data (DESIGN.md § 7): a dataset generated by rendering known patches, its train, validation and test splits, the patch samples in them, the separate diagnostic set of rejection cases, and the ModelSpec dense-data files (x.f32, y.f32, order.u32) of each split.

<DomainGraph data={domainGraph2} title="dataset" />

[Read the dataset domain in full](./patchback-dataset.md)

## dependency

The dependency gate (DESIGN.md § 3, § 12.2, invariant 7): an audit of the application-level crates of one revision. Two categories are permitted: external audio I/O, as at most one approved backend behind an optional feature, and CLI parsing, as the one approved `clap`; every other third-party application crate is refused.

<DomainGraph data={domainGraph3} title="dependency" />

[Read the dependency domain in full](./patchback-dependency.md)

## fit

Closed-loop inverse synthesis: comparisons of a rendering with a reference, bounded derivative-free fit runs, ranked topology candidates, the artifacts a fit run writes, and the benchmarks that judge the optimizer (DESIGN.md sections 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 15).

<DomainGraph data={domainGraph4} title="fit" />

[Read the fit domain in full](./patchback-fit.md)

## model

The ModelSpec bridge (DESIGN.md § 1.1, § 8): the pinned ModelSpec release, the checked `.mspec` source, `modelspec train` runs as subprocesses, the version-locked weight export and the native two-layer predictor that reads it.

<DomainGraph data={domainGraph5} title="model" />

[Read the model domain in full](./patchback-model.md)

## patch

The editable DSP program Patchback infers: a versioned patch of typed nodes and rate-checked edges, validated before it is compiled, and the topology whose module catalogue and parameter contracts it is checked against (DESIGN.md sections 2, 5 and 11).

<DomainGraph data={domainGraph6} title="patch" />

[Read the patch domain in full](./patchback-patch.md)

## score

The score that drives a patch: versioned, sample-timed note events and control automation (DESIGN.md sections 10 and 11), and, later, an arrangement of several instrument stems (section 10 V3, Milestone E).

<DomainGraph data={domainGraph7} title="score" />

[Read the score domain in full](./patchback-score.md)

## studio

What Patchback Studio, the browser view of Patchback, reads and draws (DESIGN.md section 16): the module catalogue of a topology (each atomic module kind with its ports, rates and parameter contracts), the graph of one patch with its delayed feedback marked, the evolution trace of one fit run (one frame per render evaluation, replayed from a fit run's artifacts or streamed live), and the end-result view of a run (recovered patch beside reference and render spectra). Patch, topology, fit run and render are referenced by identity type only; their rules stay in their own domains (DESIGN.md sections 5, 9, 11, 13 D; ADR-003).

<DomainGraph data={domainGraph8} title="studio" />

[Read the studio domain in full](./patchback-studio.md)
